theorem subgoal_5_S_factorization : ∀ S : Polynomial ℂ, (∀ x : ℝ, (x - 1) * S.eval (x - 3) = (x - 7) * S.eval x) → ∃ T : Polynomial ℂ, S = (X - 1) * T ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (x - 4) * T.eval (x - 3) = (x - 7) * T.eval x := by sorry

theorem subgoal_6_T_root : ∀ T : Polynomial ℂ, (∀ x : ℝ, (x - 4) * T.eval (x - 3) = (x - 7) * T.eval x) → T.eval 4 = 0 := by sorry

theorem subgoal_7_T_factorization : ∀ T : Polynomial ℂ, (∀ x : ℝ, (x - 4) * T.eval (x - 3) = (x - 7) * T.eval x) → ∃ U : Polynomial ℂ, T = (X - 4) * U ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, U.eval (x - 3) = U.eval x := by sorry

theorem subgoal_8_U_constant : ∀ U : Polynomial ℂ, (∀ x : ℝ, U.eval (x - 3) = U.eval x) → ∃ C : ℂ, U = C := by sorry
